## `~/` whoami

Hi, I'm **Manas** — I build AI systems that actually do things: agents that route emails, pipelines that turn raw datasets into decisions, and multi-modal frameworks that run on a CPU.

- Currently building **[Memori](https://github.com/manas-shukla-101/Memori)** — AI-powered memory assistant that surfaces the right info at the right time
- Portfolio: **[manas-shukla-portfolio.framer.website](https://manas-shukla-portfolio.framer.website)**
- Learning **agentic system design and multi-modal AI evaluation**
- Open to **internships and research collaborations**
